product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides agent infrastructure and ready-made autonomous company templates so founders and teams can deploy AI agent teams to operate businesses end-to-end.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes infrastructure and templates for agents to autonomously operate businesses.

pricing_page.notes: Public Standard and Pro plans are listed.

named_customers.notes: The coverage describes customer business categories but does not name any customers; no named customer roster could be found.

hq_location.notes: YC lists San Francisco as location/headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains an Engineering category and technical posts; this cited example discusses open-source attribution and what the team builds.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple product, API and SDK articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: YC job listings include Member of Technical Staff — RL and Member of Technical Staff — Agents, roles explicitly focused on AI/ML.

model_provider.notes: Public docs reviewed do not identify specific models or providers; no positive provider disclosure located.

compliance_certs.notes: Homepage and footer present product and legal links but no named SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification.

last_funding.notes: Naïve announced a $28.5 million Series A on August 6, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series A falls within the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists engineering and growth roles, not SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog lists launch posts dated November 2, 2026 and October 17, 2026, including Music and 3D Assets launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level/VP join or departure was verified. Available team/profile information is insufficient to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed job listings and docs; no CRM or sales/marketing system was visibly named.
